why: `numel` gives a double for an object whose class has no `numel` (MATLAB R2026a), and the class's own otherwise, which by the project rule gives the object back: `x = numel(x)` then `feval('sum', x)` (doc 'feval': the function a name names, dispatched as a call is) is `Cel::sum` in `@Cel/`, which has `numel.m`, and MATLAB's `sum` in `@Bare/`, which has none.
